title: Select All / checkbox toggles on the host grid are O(N²) with per-row disk stats, layout reflows, and WebView2 messages — multi-second freeze on large fleets
existing_state: SetAllCheckboxes (Form1.cs:2560-2575) loops every row setting the checkbox cell Value. Each programmatic set fires Dgv_Variables_CellValueChanged, whose checkbox branch (Form1.cs:4315-4322) calls UpdateSelectionCount for EVERY row — not once at the end. UpdateSelectionCount (Form1.cs:2536-2558) then does: a full-row scan in GetCheckedHostCount (2525-2534), a second full-row scan for totalCount (2539-2540), UpdateHostsFileIndicator, UpdateRunButtonText, and SendTargetHostToCanvas. UpdateRunButtonText (Form1.cs:11272-11296) performs a THIRD GetCheckedHostCount scan plus a Graphics allocation to measure text and button-reposition layout. SendTargetHostToCanvas -> ResolveTargetHostRow (Form1.cs:13430-13450) is a FOURTH full scan, plus a WebView2 IPC message with a full host payload built from every column when the Flow Canvas is open (13456-13496). UpdateHostsFileIndicator (Form1.cs:2370-2373) additionally calls ResolveLoadedFileSyncStatus (2343-2368) -> CsvFileSyncEvaluator.Evaluate (Utilities/CsvFileSyncEvaluator.cs:36-60), which hits the disk (File.Exists + new FileInfo) — 2 disk metadata reads per row toggle while a CSV is loaded. And when the grid is dirty, IsHostsGridUnsaved (Form1.cs:2375-2393) builds a full O(rows x cols) snapshot of the grid and deep-compares it — per row toggle. Net cost of one header select-all click on N hosts: ~4N² cell accesses + 2N disk stats + N layout reflows (+N IPC messages with canvas open). The same cascade applies to the context-menu Select All/Deselect All (Form1.cs:6523-6531), Invert Selection's loop (6533-6546), and every single checkbox click (4274-4283). The HostGridRestoreBatcher (UI/HostGridRestoreBatcher.cs:47-56) only defers these during restore/mutation scopes — SetAllCheckboxes opens no scope, and Form1.PasteFromClipboard (9604-9786) already demonstrates the handler-detachment fix.
recommendation: Wrap the SetAllCheckboxes and invert-selection loops in _hostGridRestoreBatcher.BeginMutationScope() (or a _suppressSelectionCountUpdate flag checked in Dgv_Variables_CellValueChanged, mirroring how PasteFromClipboard detaches CellValueChanged) so UpdateSelectionCount runs exactly once after the loop. Inside UpdateSelectionCount, compute checked/total in a single pass and pass the checked count into UpdateRunButtonText instead of re-scanning. Cache the CsvFileSyncEvaluator result (re-evaluate at most every 1-2s or on FileSystemWatcher events) so per-click UI updates stop doing synchronous disk IO, and skip the BuildSnapshot deep-compare on checkbox-only changes (they never affect CSV dirty state, per the comment at 4317).
user_benefit: Selecting all hosts in a 1,000+ row fleet currently locks the UI thread for seconds (and floods the canvas with hundreds of redundant IPC messages); this makes the core 'check everything and run' workflow instant.

evidence.note: SetAllCheckboxes per-row Value set, no event suppression
CellValueChanged -> UpdateSelectionCount fires once per row during the loop
UpdateSelectionCount: two full-row scans + indicator + run-button + canvas IPC
UpdateRunButtonText re-runs GetCheckedHostCount (third scan) + Graphics text measure + layout
ResolveLoadedFileSyncStatus disk stat + IsHostsGridUnsaved full snapshot deep-compare when dirty
Evaluate -> File.Exists + new FileInfo on every call
ResolveTargetHostRow fourth full scan; SetTargetHost WebView2 message per row when canvas open
